descriptions.w3d_d24b_queue_input_8008e9c0: Input queueing: when the system 0x804aab68 is active and the object's info +472 (flag +24, team index +32) names a different owner in a copy of the team list 0x8043bb64 (0x800b4d98), forwards to that owner with its current message; otherwise queues the (object, message) pair once in the pending list 0x80431e94, setting the message's queued flag +108 unless +108 or +109 is already set.
